title: BuildStatus
description: status.json in a build folder: the state of one build, and the format version of its page.json. A reader can decide from this file whether it can draw the page, without parsing page.json.

schema.description: The format version of status.json itself. It is separate from page_schema.

started.description: When collect started, as an ISO 8601 time, or null.

finished.description: When the last stage finished, as an ISO 8601 time, or null while running.

error.description: A short message when state is failed, else null.

skill_version.description: The version of the Changescape skill that wrote the build.

page_schema.description: The format version of page.json in the folder. Absent means 2.

BuildState.title: BuildState
BuildState.description: Whether the build is running, done, or failed.

BuildStage.title: BuildStage
BuildStage.description: How far the build got. facts: collect wrote the page without captions. narrated: assemble merged the agent's narration.
